key_sections_summary: OA 30–60 mg; RA/AS 60–90 mg; gout 120 mg ≤8 d; dental 90 mg ≤3 d; CrCl ≥30 no change, <30 contraindicated; Child-Pugh caps; F ~100%, PB 92%, t1/2 ~22 h, <2% unchanged urine; not dialyzable.
note: Our paraphrase of the regulator product information; numbers copied exactly. Not rendered as text.
